A '''battle''' including [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] once occurred in an [[Ruined outpost|outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. The [[Ground warfare/Legends|battle]] left the outpost in ruins and scattered the remains of many [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] within the ground. After the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Declaration of a New Republic|formation]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the battle site became of interest to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==The battle==
At some point, a battle involving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] took place in an [[Ruined outpost|outpost]] on the continent [[Laz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. The [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of Lazerian IV, the [[Akwin]], witnessed the battle and noted the presence of many "strangers with [[Lightsaber/Legends|glowing blades]]," which were [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] with their lightsabers. The battle left the grounds severely and permanently damaged; not even [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]] could grow back. Numerous lightsabers and pieces of lightsabers were left buried in the ground.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Aftermath==
Long after the battle occurred, an eccentric [[Unidentified noble|noble]] acquired the land on which the outpost stood, making it off-limits to trespassers. Other inhabitants of Lazerian IV regarded the ruins of the battle as an eyesore.<ref name="TSoK" />

{{RPGseed}}
Following the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Declaration of a New Republic|formation]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TSoKDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|declaration]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. As the New Republic is described as being an active faction in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the adventure ideas for Lazerian IV in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], they must occur after the New Republic's formation during or after 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> a group of travelers encountered the outpost and discovered the lightsabers and their pieces. They later attempted to repair at least one of them while reserving the components as spare parts. Upon hearing about the lightsabers, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] interest in the outpost grew.<ref name="TSoK" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The battle on Lazerian IV was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
